title: CmdPal: fix two hangs in top-level queries

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The reviewed ownership/subscription paths did not leave an actionable defect in the top-level-query hang fixes. The two current host-owned wrapper types retain their initialized command owners, while ordinary extension items keep their existing replacement ownership. The direct subscription assertions detect retained or duplicate handlers; replacing their instrumentation was an optional maintenance preference.

**Validation scope:** The retained assessment is source/caller-based. No exact-head passing product build or focused test execution receipt was established, so this summary does not certify runtime hang resolution.

No additional code change is requested by this assessment. This is a qualified summary, not an unconditional approval.

The latest author replies were also reassessed: the current `model.Command` is used directly as an `ICommand`, so adding `.Unsafe` is not a valid correction. The current borrowed-command calls were traced through the command's own initialization guard and the host top-level initialization chain; no additional hang was independently reproduced. The author-reported 34 lifecycle tests were not independently rerun here, and the reply is not treated as proof of a new source change.
